local-docker.description: Isolated WEB MPC Docker + Anvil stack (Compose project mpc-qa). The only environment where writes, seeded defects and load are allowed.

stack.note: The original mpc-qa project's Anvil volume refuses an unsafe restore; its volumes are preserved untouched and this fresh project is used instead.

preview.description: Vercel preview deployment on BSC testnet. Read-only API checks and wallet UI tests.

staging.description: Staging (mainnet bundle, test contracts). Refuses same-origin writes; read-only.

production.description: Production. Read-only smoke and UI regression only; never writes, load or seeded defects.
